rules.description: A valid candidate draw must span at least 3 distinct decade groups (1-9, 10-19, 20-29, 30-36).
rules.last_journal_note: Latest draw validated the 3-decade minimum spread requirement.

rules.description: The sum of all 5 drawn numbers must fall within the range of 65 to 120.
rules.last_journal_note: The latest draw sum (140) significantly exceeded the upper bound of 120. This suggests the sum window may be too restrictive during high-value number clusters.

rules.description: At least one number from draw D(t-1) carries over to draw D(t).
rules.last_journal_note: The carry-over rule has resumed after a short-term anomaly. Increasing weight to capture the return to mean behavior.

rules.description: The draw contains exactly one adjacent consecutive pair (e.g., 14, 15).
rules.last_journal_note: Consecutive pairs (32, 33) appeared in the latest draw, reinforcing the stability of the clustering rule.

rules.description: The odd-to-even ratio of selected numbers must be 3:2 or 2:3.
rules.last_journal_note: 2:3 parity ratio observed, confirming rule's high predictive value.
